{{Quote|He's got more problem children in that outfit than a k'kayeh dragon has teeth&mdash;and son, I got to tell you, that's a lot.|Almas resident [[Ezil|Old Ezil]], on the [[Organization|underworld organization]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]]|<ref name="Dark on Dark">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20020712adark&c=swlfc|text=Dark on Dark}}</ref>}}
The '''k'kayeh dragon''' was a gigantic, [[Snake/Legends|serpentine]] beast that was created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Rivan]] to defend his [[Almas Sith fortress|fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. The dragon was 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length and was covered by thick skin as strong as [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was the exact [[Color/Legends|color]] of the sands of the [[Almas Wasteland]] that surrounded Rivan's [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]. The creature preferred a subterranean lifestyle and rarely strayed to the planetary surface, instead choosing to spend most of its [[Time/Legends|time]] roaming the deep underground [[Cave/Legends|caverns]] and swimming along subterrestrial [[Water/Legends|rivers]].

After Rivan was [[Battle at Almas|driven]] from Almas during the [[New Sith Wars]], in his absence the k'kayeh continued to reside on Almas for over a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]], coming to be regarded by the population of Almas as a creature of legend. Circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] of an ancient [[Darth Rivan's holocron|holocron]] that Rivan had created summoned the dragon to [[Mission to Almas|attack]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]] and a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents inside a cavern beneath a [[Almas Academy|ruined Jedi academy]]. The agents withstood the creature's attack, and after Draco was sent tumbling off a ledge and into a deep chasm below, the k'kayeh ceased its assault and retreated.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|It was born from the energy of the dark side.|A rumor about the k'kayeh dragon that circulated among the population of Almas|<ref name="DotD" />}}
[[File:Darthriv.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Darth Rivan, the Sith Lord who created the k'kayeh dragon]]
The k'kayeh dragon was a gargantuan, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-using]]<ref name="DotD" /> [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]]<ref name="EotJ" /> monster that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Rivan]] created using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark arts]]<ref name="DotD" /> of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. The dragon had a [[Snake/Legends|serpentine]] body<ref name="EotJ" /> and was over 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, making it one of the largest guardian beasts ever to be developed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The creature's outer dermal layer was as thick as [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating and was the [[Color/Legends|color]] of sand, of the precise shade of the sands of the [[Almas Wasteland]]&mdash;an arid, [[Desert/Legends|desert]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] on which the creature resided, providing the k'kayeh with camouflage and making it indistinguishable from the region's sand dunes when viewed from above. The dragon was also amphibious and could breath [[Water/Legends|underwater]] just as easily as it could breath [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]].<ref name="DotD" />

For defense, the k'kayeh dragon had razor-sharp claws,<ref name="EotJ" /> and inside its [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] it had dozens of small, sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], as well as larger teeth taller than a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]<ref name="DotD" />&mdash;a type of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being from the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]&mdash;<ref name="NEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> that could cut through metal just as easily as a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] could. Due the nature of its creation by Rivan, and also because of its long exposure to the dark side presence that permeated the environment surrounding Rivan's [[Almas Sith fortress]], the k'kayeh was sensitive to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]; it could use the [[Force power/Legends|powers]] [[Battlemind]], [[Force sense/Legends|Force sense]], and [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force strike]] to a limited extent and could also fire bolts of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] from each of its two [[Nose/Legends|nostrils]]. The creature was immune to detection by sense-based Force abilities, and something about the dragon's nature also rendered it invisible to [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] designed to spot life forms. The dragon had an extremely long lifespan and was capable of living over a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old.<ref name="DotD" />

==Behavior and intelligence==
{{Quote|It feeds off the kaluthin.|A claim about the k'kayeh dragon's diet that circulated among the population of Almas as a rumor|<ref name="DotD" />}}
Though not fully sentient, the k'kayeh dragon possessed a limited degree of self-awareness and went to great lengths to avoid drawing the attention of the inhabitants of Almas.<ref name="DotD" /> Driven by the dark side, the k'kayeh was malevolent and attacked all beings that it encountered.<ref name="DotD" /><ref name="EotJ" />

The k'kayeh was primarily a subterranean creature and rarely came to the surface of Almas, instead choosing to spend most of its life underground, roaming the deep recesses of the planet's [[caver]]ns and swimming along frozen subterranean rivers. Its main home was an enormous underground lake formed by the convergence of several subterrestrial rivers, and the dragon would often [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]] for [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] on end before waking and returning to the planetary surface in search of food. The beast could eat anything, even [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and frequently preyed on travelers who ventured into the Almas Wasteland. However, the dragon required more food to sustain itself than it could safely obtain on the surface without altering the population of Almas to its presence. As a result, it mainly subsisted on a diet of aquatic creatures such as the [[coboko fish]], which inhabited Almas' underground rivers. The k'kayeh had a taste for [[forfra moss]], a pungent [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on the ceilings of many of Almas' tunnels; the moss was poisonous if consumed at the wrong stage in its life cycle, and the dragon took care to feed upon the plant only when the moss' scent was just right. It was also rumored by some among the inhabitants of Almas that the k'kayeh fed off the [[kaluthin]], a plant that Rivan bred to modify Almas' poisonous atmosphere.<ref name="DotD" />

When in combat, the k'kayeh used its jaws as its primary weapon to swallow its target, though when irked by small-sized creatures and objects, the creature would respond by smashing the annoyance with its large claws. When simultaneously faced with a large number of threats, the dragon would rise up almost vertically and then crash down onto its attackers in an attempt to crush them.<ref name="DotD" />

==History==
{{Quote|It was a pet to Darth Rivan, and survived him by over a thousand years.|A rumor about the k'kayeh dragon that circulated among the population of Almas|<ref name="DotD" />}}
[[File:Almas.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Almas, the planet on which the k'kayeh dragon resided]]
The k'kayeh dragon was created by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Rivan<ref name="DotD" /> at some point between 1417 BBY and 1167 BBY,<ref name="Rivan dates">The [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Echoes of the Jedi]]'' states that [[Darth Rivan]] reigned as a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] at some point between 1,400 and 1,150 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of the scenario. ''Echoes of the Jedi'' can be dated to about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] because the adventure states that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two years after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], an event that ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Therefore, Rivan's reign and his creation of the k'kayeh dragon can be dated to between 1417 BBY and 1167 BBY.</ref> amidst the turmoil of the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="EotJ" /> The creature was designed to defend Rivan's [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] on Almas against entire [[Army/Legends|armies]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;Force-wielding opponents of the Sith&mdash;that might hope to besiege the citadel.<ref name="DotD" /> Rivan was ultimately [[Battle at Almas|driven]] from Almas,<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the creature considered to reside on the world in the absence of its master for the next millennium.<ref name="DotD" />

In [[177 BBY]],<ref name="177 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' mentions that the [[Almas]] [[Jedi academy|Academy]] was founded 145 years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''The New Essential Chronology''. It can therefore be deduced that the [[School|academy]] was founded in [[177 BBY]].</ref> a [[Almas Academy|Jedi academy]] was established on Almas, and a small population of colonists gradually settled on the world.<ref name="LFCG" /> The k'kayeh dragon came to be regarded by the Almas populace as a creature of legend, and speculation about the possible existence of the creature was rampant, though stories of the beast were largely used only to scare misbehaving children. Visitors to Almas often commented upon having seen the dunes of the Almas Wasteland to be moving, as if a large serpentine creature was traversing across the sands, but no sign of the k'kayeh's presence was ever found from the investigation of such claims.<ref name="DotD" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="31 BBY">The ''Living Force Campaign Guide'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying campaign is set about one year after the Invasion of Naboo, which is dated to 32 BBY by ''The New Essential Chronology''. As such the setting of the initial stage of the campaign can be placed in circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> expeditions into the Almas Wasteland recovered several k'kayeh teeth, though despite the discovery of such evidence, the Almas people continued to regard the stories of the k'kayeh dragon as mere legend.<ref name="DotD" />

The [[Jedi academy]] on Almas was later [[Destruction of the Almas Academy|destroyed]], and in the absence of the facility's strong [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] presence, a [[Darth Rivan's holocron|Sith holocron]] that Rivan had created activated in the caves beneath the Academy. Strengthened by the dark side of the Force, the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron's]] [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] came to believe that it was the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of Rivan.<ref name="EotJ" /> Around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="17 BBY">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}} states that [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two years after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. This thus indicates that ''Dawn of Defiance'' is set in circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]] ventured to the ruined [[School|academy]] and began to study the holocron. Under the influence of the gatekeeper, Draco left various traps throughout the academy to ensnare anyone who sought to disturb him, including a k'kayeh [[dreambeast]], an [[Mind trick/Legends|illusory]] version of the real k'kayeh dragon that was about one quarter of its size and was linked to the real k'kayeh via the Force.<ref name="EotJ" />

During Draco's occupation of the academy, several [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents [[Mission to Almas|traveled]] to the ruins in search of the [[Qornah Holocron|holocron]] of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qornah]]. The agents defeated the k'kayeh dreambeast and then confronted Draco in the caverns beneath the academy, and as the Inquisitor made his final stand against the operatives, the holocron gatekeeper summoned the real k'kayeh to attack them. Using dark side skills that he had learned from Rivan's holocron, Draco was able to [[Animal bond|control]] the dragon to a limited extent, preventing it from devouring him, and the creature fired several Force lightning bolts at the agents while Draco defended himself against them. However, the agents ultimately defeated Draco and sent him tumbling off a ledge into a large cavern below, and as Draco fell, the k'kayeh retreated back into the abyss from which it had come.<ref name="EotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The k'kayeh dragon was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and was first described in ''[[Dragon of the Desert]]'', an article published on the website [[Wizards.com]] in [[2002]] as a supplement to the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] campaign. The dragon later received a brief mention in the Wizards.com article ''[[Dark on Dark]]'', also by Mullins, and in [[2008]], the dragon made an appearance in ''[[Echoes of the Jedi]]'', the fourth installment of the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' roleplaying campaign, by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Jean-François Boivin]].
